story_title: Lina and Adams and the Garden Tea Party
lesson: Learn tea party words in English!
title: Lina and Adams and the Garden Tea Party 🫖 | Tea Party Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Lina invites Adams to a tea party in the garden at sunset! When Milo the cat knocks the cookies down, Lina shares and the party is still wonderful. 🫖🍪🌇
In this English story for kids, children learn 8 new words: invite, guest, tea, cup, plate, pour, cookie and sip. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
💌 invite — يدعو / عرض على — inviter
🙋 guest — ضيف — l'invité
🫖 tea — شاي / أتاي — le thé
☕ cup — كوب / كاس — la tasse
🍽️ plate — صحن / طبسيل — l'assiette
🫗 pour — يصب / كبّ — verser
🍪 cookie — بسكويت / حلوة — le biscuit
👄 sip — رشفة / شفطة صغيرة — une petite gorgée

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: have a pretend tea party at home with toy cups and plates. Ask your child: "Can you pour the tea?" Remember: hot drinks are only for grown-ups to make. Pause after each new word and say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

lines.text: It is a calm afternoon. Lina is in her room with Milo the cat.
Milo, I have an idea! Let's have a tea party in the garden!
Lina takes a paper and draws a big heart on it.
I will invite Adams. I will write: Please come to my tea party!
To invite means to ask someone to come to your home or your party.
Say it with me: invite!
Meow! Milo wants to come too.
Lina walks to Adams's house and gives him the paper.
A tea party? For me? Thank you, Lina!
Yes! You are my guest. Please come at six o'clock.
A guest is a person you invite to your home or your party.
Can you say it? Guest!
I will be a very good guest. I will bring a flower!
Adams smiles a big smile.
In the kitchen, Mama is making mint tea.
The water is very hot, so only Mama touches the teapot.
Mmm! The tea smells so nice, Mama.
Tea is a warm drink. We make it with hot water and leaves.
Let's say it together: tea!
Mama says: We will let the tea cool down. Then it is just warm, not hot.
Now Lina needs something to drink from.
One for me, one for Adams. Two little cups!
Lina puts the cups on a tray, very carefully.
A cup is a small thing we drink from. It often has a handle.
Say it with me: cup!
Meow? Milo looks at the cups. He wants milk!
Don't worry, Milo. You will get a little bowl of milk.
Now we need something for the food. Where are the plates?
Lina finds two round, white plates.
A plate is a flat, round dish. We put food on a plate.
Can you say it? Plate!
One plate for me, one plate for Adams.
Lina puts some apple slices on the plates too. Yummy!
Mama opens the oven. Look! A tray of golden cookies!
Cookies! They are round and sweet!
A cookie is a small, sweet, flat cake. It can be soft or crunchy.
Say it with me: cookie!
Lina puts four cookies on each plate. One, two, three, four.
Adams will love these cookies!
Ding dong! Adams is here. He has a flower for Lina.
Hello, Lina! Thank you for inviting me.
Welcome, Adams! Please sit down.
The tea is warm now, not hot. Lina holds the little teapot and pours.
To pour means to let a drink go slowly from one thing into another.
Let's say it together: pour!
Pour, pour, pour. Your cup is ready, Adams!
Can I drink it all at once?
No, Adams. Take a little sip. Slowly, like this.
Lina drinks a tiny bit of tea. Sip!
A sip is a very small drink. We take a sip slowly.
Can you say it? Sip!
Sip. Mmm! It is sweet and minty!
Milo drinks his milk. Lap, lap, lap!
Then Milo sees a butterfly. He jumps on the table!
Oh no! Adams's plate falls down. The cookies land on the grass.
My cookies! Now they are dirty. I can't eat them.
Adams looks very sad. Milo looks sad too. Meow.
It is okay, Adams. It was an accident.
Milo did not mean it. Let's pick them up together.
They put the dirty cookies in the bin. Milo says sorry with a soft purr.
Now the sky is dark, and the garden lamp is on.
Adams, I have four cookies. Let's share them!
Two for you, and two for me.
Really? Thank you, Lina! You are so kind.
Sharing makes everybody happy. Now both friends have cookies.
I am a guest, and you are a great host!
They eat the cookies and sip their tea. Crunch, crunch!
Twinkle, twinkle. The stars come out in the sky.
This was the best tea party ever!
Next time, you can invite me to your house!
Yes! I will invite you, and you will be my guest.
Milo curls up next to the lamp. Purr, purr.
Adams says goodbye and walks home with his dad.
Good night, Adams! See you tomorrow!
Lina is in bed now. Milo is sleeping at her feet.
Milo, today we had tea, cookies and a good friend.
And when the cookies fell, we shared. That was the best part.
Lina closes her eyes. She dreams of a big tea party with all her friends.
Good night, Lina. Good night, Milo.
Sweet dreams, everyone!
